title: Apple is testing daily usage limits for more complex Siri AI interactions
summary: Apple released betas of iOS 27.3, iPadOS 27.3, and macOS 27.3 today, and the company is using the update to test new per device daily usage limits for some Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features, according to MacRumors. Basic Siri commands and requests will remain free and unlim
reason: Item reports Apple testing daily usage limits for existing Siri/Apple Intelligence features in iOS 27.3 betas. No named model release or new capability (R1), no research artifact (R2), no financing/M&A/partnership/revenue or product launch (R3), no policy action (R4), no OSS tooling (R5).
